_comment: Project-local Pi settings for the transboarded project root. The agentic-guard extension is auto-discovered from .pi/extensions/ after the project is trusted; project-local resources only load once trust is granted (ctx.isProjectTrusted()).
_comment_python: The guard hooks are stdlib-only Python (3.11+). Set AGENTIC_WORKFLOW_PYTHON to pin a specific interpreter; otherwise the bridge uses `py -3` on Windows and `python3` elsewhere.
